name: Chat Completions (direct)
summary: Plain /openai/v1/chat/completions on the project-scoped OpenAI client, with and without streaming.
description: The project's `get_openai_client()` returns an OpenAI client pointed at `{PROJECT_ENDPOINT}/openai/v1/`. Responses API on that client honours BYOM prefixes; Chat Completions does not — the proxy resolves the model name locally on the Foundry account and returns 404 `DeploymentNotFound` before ever reaching the APIM gateway. Covers both `stream=False` and `stream=True`.
notes: Verified live against `gpt-4o-mini` behind AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_STATIC: `aoai.chat.completions.create(model='{gateway}/gpt-4o-mini', ...)` returns 404 DeploymentNotFound for both stream/non-stream. Same model works fine on `aoai.responses.create(...)`. Use the Responses API when routing through BYOM; Chat Completions currently requires a local Foundry deployment.
